## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
- All styling lives in `style.css`. The `style="..."` attribute is **forbidden anywhere in the HTML**.
- Target every design property, layout rule, and state via class or ID selectors only.
- HTML must remain semantic and styling-agnostic: changing the look must never require markup edits.

**1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens**
Define all tokens in `:root` (dark Synthwave = default theme). Mandatory baseline plus Synthwave extension:

```css
:root {
  /* Brand */
  --primary: #FF6B35;         /* Sunset Orange */
  --secondary: #FF1493;       /* Neon Pink */
  --accent-cyan: #00FFFF;     /* Neon Cyan */
  --accent-magenta: #FF00FF;  /* Hot Magenta */
  --chrome: #C0C0C0;          /* Chrome Silver */
  --deep-purple: #2D1B69;
  --horizon-blue: #1B1464;

  /* Surfaces (dark default) */
  --bg-primary: #0A0A2E;      /* Dark Navy */
  --bg-secondary: #2D1B69;    /* Deep Purple card surface */

  /* Text */
  --text-primary: #00FFFF;    /* Neon Cyan */
  --text-secondary: #C0C0C0;   /* Chrome Silver */
  --text-success: #00FF9D;
  --text-error: #FF3355;

  /* Borders */
  --border-default: rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.8);
  --border-error: #FF3355;
  --border-success: #00FF9D;

  /* Radius — keep sharp/retro */
  --radius-sm: 2px; --radius-md: 4px; --radius-lg: 8px;

  /* Shadows + neon glow */
  --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  --shadow-md: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  --glow-pink: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.5);
  --glow-cyan: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.5);

  /* Spacing & motion */
  --spacing-gap: 1.5rem;
  --transition-fast: 150ms;
  --transition-normal: 300ms;
  --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);

  /* Elevation/stacking */
  --z-dropdown: 1000;
  --z-modal: 2000;
  --z-toast: 3000;
  --z-scanline: 4000; /* pointer-events: none — never intercepts input */

  /* Type */
  --font-display: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
  --font-base: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
}
```

- **Contrast pairing:** every light background token must pair with a dark text token and vice versa — enforce this in every theme, not just the default.
- **Light mode background:** never pure white; use warm retro tints (e.g., `#FEF6EC`, `#EDE7FF`) and `#fefefe` where a near-white is required.
- Reference tokens via `var(--...)` everywhere; raw hex values are allowed only inside `:root`/theme blocks and in the hero scene-gradient rules built from the palette above.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support**
- Dark Mode is the canonical experience and the **default on first visit** — *explicit exception per the Synthwave spec ("Light: Not Recommended"): default to dark regardless of `prefers-color-scheme`.*
- Implement themes as pure token overrides: dark tokens in `:root`; a light "Daytime Retro" variant under a `.theme-light` class on `<html>`. Background and text variables must swap seamlessly with **no HTML restructuring**.
- The light variant must preserve the neon identity: darkened neon borders/text for WCAG contrast, softened glows, sunset-tinted light surfaces.
- **Persistence:** store the user's choice in `localStorage` (e.g., key `synthwave-theme`); apply it before first paint to prevent flash; fall back to dark.
- **Toggle:** a visible icon button in the header using Material Symbols (`dark_mode` / `light_mode`) with correct `aria-pressed` and a dynamic `aria-label` ("Switch to light mode" / "Switch to dark mode").

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
- Build all layout structures with Flexbox (CSS Grid permitted only for equal card rows).
- Every flex container **defaults to `align-items: center`**; any deviation (e.g., `flex-start` for long-form card text) requires a CSS comment stating the exception.
- Mobile-first: multi-column rows collapse to a single column on small viewports. **Horizontal scrolling is forbidden at any width** — the 3D grid floor must be clipped with `overflow: hidden`.

**1.5 Framework Default & Styling Approach**
- Use clean custom CSS in `style.css` as the single styling source, organized with native CSS `@layer` (tokens → base → components → utilities). Do not mix in utility-framework classes.
- Map all styles to the tokens above and to generic reusable classes (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`, `.section`, `.container`).

**1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
- Load via Google Fonts `<link>` tags (with `preconnect`): **Orbitron** (400–900) for display/headings and **Rajdhani** (400–700) for body text; bind them to `--font-display` / `--font-base`.
- All UI icons must be **Google Material Symbols** (loaded via the official stylesheet). Raw inline SVGs and local icon files are forbidden for UI icons.
- **Exception (per Synthwave spec):** the decorative palm tree silhouettes — and the retro sun, if drawn — may be inline SVG or pure CSS; they are `aria-hidden` scene decoration, not UI icons.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

**2.1 Buttons** — style every state via classes; BEM variants `.btn`, `.btn--primary`, `.btn--secondary`, `.btn--icon`:
- **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target 44×44px; Orbitron uppercase label with letter-spacing. Primary = sunset gradient fill (`#FF6B35 → #FF1493`) with `--glow-pink`; secondary = transparent with a 2px `--accent-cyan` monoline border.
- **Hover:** intensified glow + `cursor: pointer`.
- **Focus:** distinct ring via `outline` (2px `--accent-cyan`, offset) plus glow — clearly visible in both themes.
- **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)`.
- **Loading:** disables pointer events, prevents double-clicks, renders a CSS spinner or rotating Material Symbol without changing button dimensions.
- **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, grayscale, `cursor: not-allowed`.
- **Success/Error:** temporary feedback styles driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error`, communicated with icon + text, never color alone.

**2.2 Cards** (Features, Pricing tiers, Testimonials):
- **Default:** flex column, `--bg-secondary` surface, 1–2px monoline `--border-default`, `--radius-md`, `--shadow-sm`.
- **Hover:** `transform: translateY(-2px)` plus a glow shift (`--glow-pink` or `--glow-cyan`).
- **Focus-within:** border switches to a cyan glow when a child link/button receives focus.
- **Loading (Skeleton):** define shimmer keyframes and a `.skeleton` utility in CSS to prevent layout jumps for any dynamically injected content.
- **Empty State:** define a reusable `.empty-state` pattern (large Google Icon + short guidance text) for any dynamically loaded region.

**2.3 Forms & Inputs** (Final CTA email capture):
- **Structure:** a flex `.input-group` wrapping a `<label>`, an `<input type="email">`, and a dedicated error feedback element bound via `aria-describedby`, inside an `aria-live="polite"` region.
- **States (all class-driven):** empty; focused (cyan outline ring + glow); filled; valid (`--border-success` + check Material Symbol); invalid (`--border-error`, error icon, error text message — icon + copy, never color alone); disabled; read-only.
- **Submit:** `preventDefault`, validate the email, move the button into loading, then show success feedback announced via the live region; no page reload.

**2.4 FAQ Accordion (and Modal, only if added):**
- **Accordion:** each item is a `<button>` header with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`, a rotating chevron Material Symbol, and a panel with `role="region"` + `aria-labelledby`; operable via Enter/Space; smooth CSS height/opacity transition; one panel open at a time; visible focus ring on headers.
- **Modal:** not required by the section list — if you add one anyway, it must have `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal`, a backdrop overlay, a Material `close` icon button with `aria-label`, focus trapping with focus return, Esc and overlay-click closing, CSS-animated open/close, and `z-index: var(--z-modal)`.

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

- **Responsive by default:** fluid `clamp()` typography, no horizontal overflow at any width, all multi-column layouts collapse gracefully.
- **Smooth animations:** every state change uses `transition: var(--transition-normal) var(--ease-standard)`; animate only `transform`/`opacity`; **respect `prefers-reduced-motion`** — pause the grid scroll and pulsing glows, keep instant state changes.
- **Scanline overlay:** fixed full-viewport `repeating-linear-gradient` (2–3px lines), opacity 0.04–0.08, `pointer-events: none`, `z-index: var(--z-scanline)` — it must never intercept clicks or hurt readability.
- **Accessibility (a11y):** semantic landmarks (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section[aria-labelledby]`, `footer`); one `h1`, one `h2` per section, `h3` for cards/steps/tiers/FAQ items; a skip-to-content link; WCAG AA contrast in both themes (body text ≥ 4.5:1, large display text ≥ 3:1); never rely on color alone for state; full keyboard operability and logical focus order; `aria-live` regions for dynamic form feedback.
- **Mandatory visual feedback:** every click, hover, and submission triggers a visible state change.
- **Destructive actions:** none expected; if any are added, a `.btn--danger` style must be visually distinct in both themes.
